languagePreference.title: Interface language
languagePreference.description: Your chosen language is saved to your account and applied when you sign in from another browser or device. Your client records and notes are not translated.
languagePreference.accountUnset: No language preference is saved to your account; the default language is Turkish.
languagePreference.accountUnavailable: Your language preference cannot be saved to your account at the moment; your choice applies to this device only.
languagePreference.savedAccount: Your language preference has been saved to your account.
languagePreference.savedDevice: The language has been changed for this device; it could not be saved to your account.
languagePreference.saveError: The language could not be changed. Please try again.
